title: An uploaded photo stops at a manual scan-approval gate, and the library names the wrong cause — so nobody knows to open it and the document is never read
evidence: Two of my three uploads (both images) sat at data-stage="queued" for 477 s with the badge reading 'לא משויך' and the sub-line 'צריך לשייך אותו לחשבונית או לקבלת סחורה' (out/documents/upload-watch.json, observations 4s..477s; screenshot out/documents/41-documents-list.png). Opening the document shows the real requirement: 'ממתין לאישור' with a button 'אישור והמשך לחילוץ' (out/documents/20-review-queued-69517a3e.png). I clicked it at 22:14:08Z and the document reached 'נדרשת בדיקה' 223 s later (out/documents/scan-approve.json). The same gate is holding older documents: 'WhatsApp Image 2026-08-16 at 14.02.58.jpeg' uploaded 02.09 (2 days), two 'consolidated-page-1.png' uploaded 03.09. Root cause in code: ACTIVE_RAW_STATUSES in src/lib/documentStatus.ts:110-112 lists queued/leased/extracted/interpreting/processing and omits 'awaiting_scan', so documentUiStatus falls past 'processing' to isUnassigned; src/lib/useDocumentProcessing.ts:461 maps awaiting_scan→'queued', so the two modules disagree about the same state. NOTE FOR DEDUPE: git log shows src/lib/documentStatus.ts was NOT touched by PR #244, so this predates the deploy — reclassify as KNOWN if round 1 already recorded it.
repro: Sign in as office. /documents → העלאת מסמך → pick any .jpeg/.png → העלאה. Watch the row: the badge says 'לא משויך — צריך לשייך אותו לחשבונית או לקבלת סחורה' and never changes. Open /documents/<id>/review and press 'אישור והמשך לחילוץ'; extraction then completes in ~4 minutes.
expected: A document waiting for its scan to be approved reads as work waiting on a person, and names that action — e.g. 'ממתין לאישור סריקה' with a link into the review screen.
actual: It reads as a filing problem ('לא משויך') and instructs the user to attach it to an invoice or goods receipt — an action that neither starts the reading nor is possible yet. The document is never read, and the failure looks like housekeeping.

title: The review screen says the invoice number and date are missing while displaying both, extracted and marked 'זוהה בבירור'
evidence: U3 (א.ע עלים ירוקים — חשבונית 2026-08.jpeg): 'מה עודכן ולאן' says 'למה לא נכתב ליעד: חסרים מספר חשבונית או תאריך, ולכן לא ניתן ליצור רשומה כספית.' while 'פירוט מהמסמך → שדות מוצעים 7' on the same page shows 'מספר חשבונית SI266001312 · זוהה בבירור' and 'תאריך חשבונית 31/07/26 · זוהה בבירור' (out/documents/review-detail.json). U2 (WhatsApp Image 2026-08-02 at 16.59.59.jpeg): same sentence, while the fields show 'מספר חשבונית SI266001938' and 'תאריך חשבונית 30/06/26', both 'זוהה בבירור' (out/documents/exits.json, u2Fields; u2SaysMissing=true). Both values match the printed documents exactly (fixture zooms out/documents/50-fixture-header-zoom.png, 51-u2-header-rot.png). Reproduced on a document read on 19.08 too, so it is not caused by this deploy.
repro: Open /documents/69517a3e-36db-41ee-9948-aeb72239fa73/review, expand 'פירוט מהמסמך', and compare the field list with the 'למה לא נכתב ליעד' sentence.
expected: Either the record is created, or the blocking sentence names the real obstacle (unmapped catalogue lines, a line-sum mismatch) so the user has something to act on.
actual: It names two fields that are present and confidently extracted. There is no action the user can take in response, and the true obstacle is never stated.

title: 'סכום שורות' reads 0.00 ₪ while 22 extracted line totals are on the same screen — creating a blocking 'header ≠ lines' finding the user cannot clear, next to a panel that says the numbers reconcile
evidence: U3: 'חשבון המסמך' shows סכום שורות 0.00 ₪, הנחות 0.00 ₪, סה״כ לפני מע״מ 20,720.80 ₪, מע״מ 133.20 ₪, סה״כ מוצהר 20,854.00 ₪, פער בלתי מוסבר 0.00 ₪ and the sentence 'המספרים מסתדרים בתוך הסטייה המותרת' — while the blocking list above it says 'סה"כ שבכותרת אינו שווה לסכום השורות' (out/documents/final.json, accounting.U3). The source panel lists all 22 line totals (33.60, 600.00, 335.40, 1,890.00, …) which sum to 20,720.70. Identical on U2 (10 lines, סכום שורות 0.00 ₪). Pressing 'אישור המסמך' returns HTTP 500 from rpc/apply_reviewed_document with body {"code":"55000","message":"document_review_blocked: header_total_differs_from_lines, product_unidentified"} (out/documents/approve.json). Not caused by unmapped products: '93_00002007 — חלק 1.pdf' (uploaded 02.09) has an unmapped line and still shows סכום שורות 9,759.92 ₪. Suspect 0298 ('one parser for a price') — I could not find a pre-deploy multi-line document to prove REGRESSION, so this is labelled NEW.
repro: Open /documents/69517a3e-36db-41ee-9948-aeb72239fa73/review. Read 'חשבון המסמך' (סכום שורות 0.00) against 'פירוט מהמסמך → שורות מוצעות 22'. Press 'אישור המסמך' and read the network response for rpc/apply_reviewed_document.
expected: סכום שורות either sums the 22 extracted line totals (20,720.70) or, with no data, shows '—' — never a fabricated 0.00. The two panels must not contradict each other.
actual: 0.00 ₪ is presented as a measured figure, it drives a blocking finding, and the panel beside it simultaneously declares the numbers reconcile.

title: Yield: 3 documents uploaded, 3 read accurately, 0 produced a business record — and nothing errored
evidence: U1 ADTV receipt (pdf): supplier אד טי וי בע"מ, amount 69.62, date 2026-07-28 — all correct — but 'אישור המסמך' is disabled ('לסוג המסמך הזה אין עדיין מסלול אישור'), 0 line items extracted from a receipt that prints 2. U2 and U3: every header field and every line value correct against the printed page, but the approval is refused by the server (DOC-03) and the screen misstates the reason (DOC-02). All three still read 'המסמך נקרא, אך עדיין לא נכתבה רשומה ביעד'. Across the whole run: 0 page errors, 0 failed requests, 1 HTTP error (the 500 above). The only path that does write — 'יצירת טיוטת חשבונית מהמסמך' — carries the wrong date (DOC-05) and requires a person to finish the form by hand.
repro: Upload three documents, take each to its review screen, press the approval on each, then reload /documents and look for any invoice, receipt or payment record created from them.
expected: At least one of three well-read documents reaches a business record, or the screen states an obstacle the user can act on.
actual: 3 read, 0 written, and every message about why is either wrong (DOC-02) or points at a self-inflicted zero (DOC-03).

title: The invoice draft built from a document carries today's date instead of the invoice date the document declares
evidence: Clicking 'יצירת טיוטת חשבונית מהמסמך' on U3 lands on /invoices/new?document=69517a3e-… with supplier, currency ILS, מספר חשבונית SI266001312, סכום לפני מע"מ 20720.8, מע"מ 133.2 and סה"כ 20854 all correctly pre-filled — but תאריך חשבונית is 04/09/2026, today, while the document prints 31/07/26 and the extraction shows 'תאריך חשבונית 31/07/26 · זוהה בבירור'. Screenshot out/documents/71-u3-after-draft.png.
repro: Open /documents/69517a3e-36db-41ee-9948-aeb72239fa73/review → 'יצירת טיוטת חשבונית מהמסמך' → read the תאריך חשבונית field.
expected: The extracted invoice date pre-fills the field, exactly as the number and amounts do.
actual: The field defaults to today. Saving as offered books a July invoice into September, which moves it in aging, in the monthly report and in any payment-terms calculation. I deliberately did NOT save the draft.

title: A document read and classified with full confidence has its approval permanently disabled and offers no alternative action
evidence: U1 (ADTV Ltd receipt 7352, id a8f52c6b-bef7-4c7d-bd6e-f246a0827f4e): classified 'אישור תשלום · זוהה בבירור', supplier and amount correct, and the 'אישור המסמך' button is disabled=true (out/documents/approve.json, u1ApproveBtn). The screen says 'לסוג המסמך הזה אין עדיין מסלול אישור' and 'לסוג המסמך הזה אין עדיין פקודת כתיבה אוטומטית בטוחה ליעד העסקי, ולכן הוא ממתין להשלמה — גם בזיהוי מלא.' There is no other button on the screen that would move it forward. The same is true of the copy uploaded on 03.09, so every receipt uploaded to this tenant ends here.
repro: Upload any payment receipt (קבלה). Open its review screen. There is nothing to press.
expected: Either an approval path for this document type, or an instruction naming what the person should do instead (file it against an existing payment, archive it).
actual: The state is named ('no approval route yet') and no next step is offered. The document is a permanent dead end.

title: A file name mixing Hebrew and Latin renders with its extension torn off and re-parked, and the element drawing it carries no bidi isolation
evidence: Measured, not eyeballed: per-character Range rects sorted by x. 'א.ע עלים ירוקים — חשבונית 2026-08.jpeg' renders left-to-right as 'jpeg.2026-08 תינובשח — םיקורי םילע ע.א', i.e. the reader sees '… חשבונית jpeg.2026-08'. '93_00002007 — חלק 3.pdf' renders as '93_00002007 — חלק pdf.3'. 'א.ע עלים ירוקים.pdf' renders as 'א.ע עלים ירוקים pdf.'. Six such names measured on /documents; every drawing element came back tag=BUTTON, dirAttr=null, direction=rtl, unicode-bidi=normal (out/documents/review-detail.json, bidiList; screenshot out/documents/41-documents-list.png row 1 and row 7). This deploy shipped src/lib/fileNameIsolation.spec.ts, which asserts this class is closed; the guard is a source scan and the sanctioned forms (<bdi>, dir="auto") do not fix a name whose first strong character is Hebrew — dir=auto then resolves RTL and the Latin extension is reordered anyway.
repro: Open /documents and read the first column for any file whose name contains both Hebrew and Latin characters.
expected: The name reads as it is stored, extension last.
actual: The extension is displayed before the trailing digits, or at the far end of the name.

title: The line grid shows '—' under 'מחיר במסמך' for every line, while the price for that same line is extracted and displayed lower on the page
evidence: U3's grid header is תיאור | כמות במסמך | הוזמן | התקבל | מחיר במסמך | מחיר מוסכם | הפרש; all 22 rows show the quantity and then '—' in every remaining column (out/documents/review-detail.json, u3Tables[0]). The source panel on the same screen gives 'מחיר ליחידה: 4.20 ש"ח' for line 1, 50.00 for line 2, 12.90 for line 3, and so on — all matching the printed page to the agora.
repro: Open /documents/69517a3e-36db-41ee-9948-aeb72239fa73/review and compare the 'מחיר במסמך' column with 'פירוט מהמסמך → שורות מוצעות'.
expected: 'מחיר במסמך' shows the price the document states — that is the reviewer's whole comparison against 'מחיר מוסכם'.
actual: It is empty on every line, so the comparison the screen exists to make cannot be made. (Caveat: I could not rule out that the column is deliberately blank until a line is mapped to a catalogue product.)

title: A business-rule refusal of a document approval is returned as HTTP 500
evidence: POST rest/v1/rpc/apply_reviewed_document → 500, body {"code":"55000","details":null,"hint":null,"message":"document_review_blocked: header_total_differs_from_lines, product_unidentified"} (out/documents/approve.json). The UI renders it correctly as findings, so the user sees no error page.
repro: Press 'אישור המסמך' on a document with blocking findings and read the network response.
expected: A refused review is a 4xx condition; 5xx belongs to faults.
actual: Every blocked approval registers as a server error in monitoring, which hides real 500s in the noise.

title: A Hebrew file name is stripped to nothing in the storage object key
evidence: Uploading 'א.ע עלים ירוקים — חשבונית 2026-08.jpeg' produced the object key …/documents/<org>/inbox/bec200e7-2f07-4b44-a07e-1afd9cc793e0__._2026-08.jpeg — every Hebrew character removed. A Latin name keeps its name in full: …/inbox/67e4fa83-…_WhatsApp_Image_2026-08-02_at_16.59.59.jpeg (out/documents/scan-approve.json, network). The tenant prefix is correct in both cases and the display name is preserved in the database, so this is not data loss.
repro: Upload a file whose name is Hebrew and read the signed-URL path on the review screen.
expected: A transliterated or at least partially recognisable object key, as Latin names get.
actual: Every Hebrew-named upload lands as '__._<ext>' behind its uuid, so nothing in the bucket is identifiable without a database lookup.

title: POST functions/v1/interpret-document returned 409 during a three-file upload burst
evidence: One 409 on functions/v1/interpret-document recorded immediately after three uploads submitted within 15 s (out/documents/upload-watch.json, collector.httpErrors, where='documents-after'). All three documents registered and none was lost, and the affected document later reached 'נדרשת בדיקה', so this looks like an idempotency conflict rather than a lost job.
repro: Upload three documents back to back and watch functions/v1/interpret-document.
expected: Either no conflict, or a conflict that is not surfaced as an HTTP error.
actual: A 409 in the log with no user-visible consequence.

title: Nothing in the product links to the goods-receipt detail route (severity unchanged)
evidence: No a[href*="/receipts/"] anywhere on /receiving as office (out/documents/exits.json, receiptLinks = []). A nonsense id refuses cleanly: 'לא ניתן לטעון את הקבלה. ייתכן שהרשומה אינה קיימת או שאין לך הרשאה לצפות בה.' (out/documents/75-receipt-bogus.png). Mentioned only to confirm ROUTES.md's note; severity has not changed.
repro: Open /receiving as office and search the DOM for links to /receipts/.
expected: A receipt row links to its detail page.
actual: The route exists and refuses bad input correctly, but is unreachable by clicking.

area: invoice intake (reached from documents — belongs to the finance surface)
title: The invoice form labels VAT as 17.5% while both scanned documents print 18.00% and the extraction agrees
evidence: The field label on /invoices/new reads 'מע״מ (17.5%)' (out/documents/71-u3-after-draft.png). The pre-filled value carried from the document is 133.2, which is 18.00% of the 740.00 VAT-liable base the document prints; the second document prints 'מע"מ (18.00%) 8,630.09'. Flagging cross-surface — the rate may be an organisation setting rather than a constant, which I did not check.
repro: Open /documents/69517a3e-…/review → 'יצירת טיוטת חשבונית מהמסמך' and read the VAT field label.
expected: The label states the rate actually in force, or no rate at all.
actual: It states 17.5% beside a value computed at 18%; a user who recomputes from the label gets a different number.
